name: agent-autonomy-harness-codex
description: Thin Codex reference candidate for demand-driven task delivery through one implicit Skill and native host capabilities.

interface.shortDescription: Delivers goals with demand-driven routing and continuity
interface.longDescription: A pre-release thin reference-host projection with one implicit task-facing Skill. It relies on current Codex-native capability, authorization, compaction, model, delegation and conversation-topology surfaces; it adds no MCP, App, command Hook, private capture state, external interpreter or persistent runtime. Controlled application evidence must still prove whether those native surfaces are sufficient before any residual control is added.
defaultPrompt: Tell me the result you want. I will own the capability route, continuity, verification, and cleanup.
